sources.ensdf: ENSDF through the IAEA LiveChart API (https://www-nds.iaea.org/relnsd/v1/), extracted 2026-11-03; raw responses in ensdf_*.csv. 248Cm levels and 252Cf alpha radiations: evaluator C.D. Nesaraja, cut-off 30-Jun-2024. 252Cf ground state (half-life, decay branches): Mattera, Zhu, Hayes, McCutchan, cut-off 1-Jan-2021.
sources.Q_alpha: AME2020 (LiveChart field qa). Same value from the knowledge-base mass table atomicmass,ame2020.txt: 76034.610 - 67392.748 - 2424.916 keV.
sources.beta: Input of Ni & Ren 2010 Table I (data/cases.json); a model input, not a measurement.

notes: Alpha intensities are per 100 decays of 252Cf. Branching ratios compared with the model are normalized to the sum of the four channels. The API gives an unusable 6+ intensity uncertainty (6e-8), so it is left null; the 8+ branch (6e-5 %) is outside the four-channel model.
